title: jina-embeddings-v5-omni：基于冻结塔组合的文本几何保持多模态嵌入
summary: 提出冻结编码器模型组合方法，通过仅训练0.35%的连接组件，将Jina Embeddings v5文本模型扩展为支持图像、音频和视频的多模态嵌入模型，性能与更大模型相当。
summary_en: Introduces frozen-encoder model composition, extending Jina Embeddings v5 text models to support image, audio, and video by training only 0.35% of weights, achieving competitive multimodal embedding performance.
